- Digital Daijisen and Nihon Kokugo Daijiten also record a literary
  flower-petal sense of くちびる. [花](花.md) is therefore a guarded
  comparison, not a reliably wrong flower-related choice. This does not
  make a petal and an entire flower interchangeable in every context.
② 花びら。花弁。[初出の実例]「誰か謂(い)つし花ものいはずと、軽漾(けいやう)激して影脣を動かす〈菅原文時〉」(出典：和漢朗詠集（1018頃）上)
咲 is the character in 咲く さく, to bloom or flower. Learn that native verb for a flower opening. The dictionary example for ショウ below concerns laughter, a different lexical use.
It means "flower", and also "blossom" and, in compounds, things that look like flowers, such as 花火.

**Modern-shape mnemonic, not etymology:** notice the [辰](辰.md)-shaped
upper part above the small 口. Imagine the lower box as a mouth with
prominent lips. This is an invented memory picture, not an account of the
character's historical formation or its sound component.
形声。口と、音符辰(シン)とから成る。口をふるわせておどろく意を表し、転じて、「くちびる」の意に用いる。

[字形] 形声
声符は辰(しん)。辰は蜃の初文。〔説文〕二上に「[image without alt text]くなり」とあり、震驚の意とする。卜文に[image without alt text]に作る字があり、「今夕、師は[image without alt text](しん)すること[image without alt text](な)きか」のように卜する。夜半に、軍中が何ごとかに震驚するというようなことがあったのであろう。唇下の口は祝[image without alt text]を示す[image without alt text](さい)の形で、蜃によって占卜する意の字形かと考えられる。のち唇を口脣の意に用いる。辰に振動の意がある。

comparisons.reason: Daijisen and Nikkoku record a flower-petal sense of くちびる (evidence/external-snapshots/02-extract.txt:16, :27); 咲 teaches flowers blooming (repo/kanji/咲.md:20)
comparisons.disposition: Collision needing exclusion at the card's own standard: the 花 guard is justified by flower-related ambiguity (snapshot/kanji/唇.md:62-65) and 花 itself is glossed flower/blossom/bloom/petal (evidence/jmdict-families.xml:140-146); "blossom; bloom" is the same answer space. Not declared on either endpoint (snapshot/kanji/唇.md:14; repo/kanji/咲.md:1-12). See F1

comparisons.reason: Nikkoku noun しん includes a labial speech sound (evidence/external-snapshots/02-extract.txt:29); 声 also has a linguistics "voiced sound" sense
comparisons.disposition: Harmless: a labial consonant is a place of articulation, not a voice or voicing; the 唇 card itself limits the sound guard to the broad 音 label (snapshot/kanji/唇.md:79-81) and 声 card centres on voice of a speaker or animal (repo/kanji/声.md:20). Pair not declared; none needed

comparisons.reason: Shared head word "edge" with the old-dictionary ホトリ gloss under variant 脣 (evidence/external-snapshots/02-extract.txt:64) whose JMdict family means side/edge/bank/shore of water
comparisons.disposition: Harmless: "cutting edge" names the sharpened part of a blade (repo/kanji/刃.md:20), not a border or waterside; ホトリ is a variant-only historical gloss. Pair not declared; none needed

comparisons.reason: ホトリ side gloss vs 横's secondary noun sense "side of something" (repo/kanji/横.md:20)
comparisons.disposition: Harmless: displayed label is "horizontal"; the lateral-side sense is not the waterside/edge sense of ほとり and neither is an ordinary meaning of 唇 (snapshot/kanji/唇.md:73-78). Pair not declared; none needed

comparisons.reason: Petal sense; 花片 is a rare petal spelling in the はなびら family
comparisons.disposition: Harmless: 片 alone means one side or a thin piece (repo/kanji/片.md:20); the petal meaning belongs to the whole word 花片/はなびら, not to "one-sided; sheet". Pair not declared; none needed
Harmless: ほとり glosses are side/edge/bank/shore of a waterbody (repo/kanji/辺.md:20), not suburbs; 郊 concerns a town's outskirts (repo/kanji/郊.md:20). Pair not declared; none needed

comparisons.reason: Jitsu おどろく surprise/fright sense (evidence/external-snapshots/02-extract.txt:61); KANJIDIC2 lists "fear" for 危
comparisons.disposition: Harmless: displayed "danger" and the card's teaching (repo/kanji/危.md:20-21) describe hazard, not being startled; the fear-type labels 恐/怖 are already guarded on 唇. Pair not declared; none needed

Harmless: no opened evidence gives 唇 a speaking/talk sense; the 口 family has speech senses but 唇 (evidence/jmdict-families.xml) and the card do not; 話 card teaches talking (repo/kanji/話.md:22). Pair not declared; none needed

comparisons.reason: Lips as a speech organ; labial speech sound
comparisons.disposition: Harmless: 語 means word/language (repo/kanji/語.md:20-21); a labial sound is not a word or language. Pair not declared; none needed

comparisons.reason: Adjacent mouth part; 唇歯 "lips and teeth"
comparisons.disposition: Harmless: distinct body part (repo/kanji/歯.md:19); 唇歯 pairs the two rather than equating them. Pair not declared; none needed

comparisons.reason: Labial speech-sound sense vs sound-family titles
comparisons.disposition: Harmless: 響 concerns sound resounding or carrying (repo/kanji/響.md:21-23), not a speech sound produced by the lips. Pair not declared; none needed

comparisons.reason: 唇 is the lips around the mouth; 口 card lists openings and speech uses (repo/kanji/口.md:19-21)
comparisons.disposition: Already handled: lips are part of the mouth, so "mouth" is defensible for 唇; direct exclusion declared on 唇 (snapshot/kanji/唇.md:14), not on 口

comparisons.reason: Petal sense of くちびる; 花 card says it also means blossom (repo/kanji/花.md:22)
comparisons.disposition: Already handled: declared on 唇 (snapshot/kanji/唇.md:14); supports F1 parity because 花's own teaching includes "blossom"
